answer: Seed the work queue with decoys. Each hides an anchor: a marker earned only by running the task, a pearl that opens only when worked. Five decoys per agent per epoch, hidden among real jobs. The agent submits output plus marker; a wrong marker fails closed: no pay, task failed. A false claim costs a $5 bond and one strike; three strikes burns the bond and suspends the identity. A sybil with 100 fakes faces 500 decoys: solving costs $0.40 each, $200 per epoch, while faking forfeits $500 in bonds plus all 100 identities. Only real work survives, like shale splitting to show the true layer.
